_description: Background music. Each track under 'music' uses EITHER 'synth' (name of a built-in melody in src/game/audio/songs/, e.g. "picnic" = upbeat and cozy, "meadow" = slow and warm, "overcast" = slow, gray and wistful) OR 'file' (path to an mp3/ogg inside public/, e.g. "assets/audio/title.mp3"). 'volume' is 0 to 1.
_usedIn: Simulation page → Start screen, Title screen, Intro slides (a slideshow picks its track with "music" in its sequences/*.json file)

title._location: Starts after the first click ('Click anywhere to begin') and plays on the opening page.

intro._location: Intro slides (the title music crossfades into this). Fades out at '6 months later'.
